title: Lifecycle state machine and transport-neutral service contract
commit_message: feat(lifecycle): add typed state machine and service ports

deliverables.vm_state_enum: 8 states: Created, Configured, Running, Paused, Snapshotting, Restoring, Stopped, Failed; derives Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash; serde snake_case
deliverables.transition_function: fn transition(from: VmState, to: VmState) -> Result<VmState, MicrovmError>; 12 explicit legal transitions + any→Failed; illegal returns ErrorCode::InvalidTransition with from/to context
deliverables.lifecycle_service_trait: async_trait LifecycleService with create, start, stop, snapshot, restore, status, metrics; transport-neutral, backend-neutral
deliverables.vm_metrics: Placeholder: vm_id, state (real metrics in todo 23)
